title: Making Things

standard_text: Things people make by hand: artisans such as potters, weavers, carpenters and blacksmiths; their tools; raw materials and the steps of making things; crafts of different states; reusing materials (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 11).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 3 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 11: artisans and what they make, tools, raw materials, the steps of making pots and cloth, and famous crafts of India. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Artisans make useful and beautiful things by hand.
key_sub: Clay → pot, cotton → cloth, bamboo → basket.
body_html:
How to think about it

Artisans are skilled people who make things by hand. A potter shapes clay on a wheel and bakes it in a kiln; a weaver weaves thread into cloth on a loom; a carpenter makes furniture from wood; a blacksmith makes iron tools.

Every product starts from a raw material: pots from clay, cloth from cotton, baskets from bamboo and paper from wood pulp or old paper. Each state has famous crafts, such as Madhubani painting in Bihar and Channapatna toys in Karnataka.

Example

Who makes furniture from wood?

uses a saw and a chisel

Answer: a carpenter

Example

Clay pot: after shaping on the wheel?

it must lose water

Answer: dry it in the sun

Common mistakes

  • Baking a pot before shaping it.
  • Thinking cloth comes from wool only.
  • Thinking handmade things are all the same.
